name: Viridian
desc: Viridian is a Ganymede NPC. They are one of the disciples the player is required to speak to in order to obtain Oathless.
additional_info:
-   Their Ganymede aspect variant is Hyperion.
-   They are named after a city in the Kanto region from the _Pokémon_ franchise. Namely, _Viridian City_.
    -   This follows the same pattern with the other Oathless npcs. For more information you can look at [Cerulean](entity:cerulean), [Saffron](entity:saffron), and [Celadon](entity:celadon).
-   Viridian usually means the shade of the color green.
-   Weirdly enough, [Saffron](entity:saffron) has a unique dialogue compared to the other disciples, being "Those eyes... You wish to" and continue. While the others, Viridian and [Celadon](entity:celadon), saying "Those eyes.. you wish to" and continue.
    -   The only difference these have is that, Saffron has 3 dots and a capitalized Y in "You", while the others have 2 dots and a lower case Y in "you"
